newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-IPALCO raised to outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-IPALCO raised to outperform.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Wednesday it raised its rating for the six months on IPALCO Enterprises Inc to outperform from market performer to reflect the financial restructuring the company disclosed late Tuesday.

-- "We have not yet revised our estimates, but expect to find higher total return potential achieved through stock repurchases, debt reductions and stronger cash flow," said analyst Dan Rudakas in a report.
-- There will be a net increase in financial leverage and a 33 percent reduction in the dividend, Rudakas noted.
